name: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Train the machines that will one day replace everyone, starting with a soul-crushing grind of data scrubbing and dawn shifts. Survive it, and choose between revered scientist and the most feared executive in the sim world.

branches.name: Engineer Track
branches.description: The grind: seven-day weeks, pre-dawn starts, and pay that insults your intelligence, all for the chance to touch the models themselves.

levels.title: Data Janitor
levels.description: Scrub duplicate cat photos out of training data for pocket change.
levels.promotion_message: You're in. Barely. You'll spend your days scrubbing duplicate cat photos from training sets for less than a barista makes. Welcome to the grind.

levels.title: Label Monkey
levels.description: Label images at dawn, seven days a week, and pretend it builds character.
levels.promotion_message: Somehow you impressed someone. Now you label images at 7 AM, seven days a week. The word 'junior' has never felt more accurate.

levels.title: Junior ML Engineer
levels.description: Write real code that breaks in ways nobody can reproduce.
levels.promotion_message: You're a real engineer now, which means the bugs are your fault and the on-call pager is your pillow. Congratulations?

levels.title: Hyperparameter Herder
levels.description: Tune hyperparameters before sunrise and take the blame when the model hallucinates.
levels.promotion_message: The company noticed your models stop exploding when you touch them. You now herd hyperparameters before dawn, six days a week.

levels.title: ML Engineer
levels.description: Ship models that mostly work and attend standups that mostly never end.
levels.promotion_message: A real title, a real desk, and a coffee machine that mostly works. The grind continues, but the numbers next to your name are climbing.

levels.title: Senior Model Wrangler
levels.description: Wrangle junior engineers and the legacy model nobody dares retrain.
levels.promotion_message: You've been promoted to Senior Model Wrangler. Junior engineers now scrub the cat photos, and you get to tell them it builds character.

levels.title: Lead Pipeline Engineer
levels.description: Own the whole pipeline, the pager, and the ten-hour days that never quite end.
levels.promotion_message: You run the pipeline end to end now. HR calls the ten-hour days 'a lifestyle choice.' One more push and you can pick your path: research, or the dark side.

branches.name: Research Track
branches.description: Stay hands-on with the models, publish leaderboard-breaking research, and trade the grind for a one-day work week.

levels.title: Staff Research Engineer
levels.description: Do actual science on the models themselves, four glorious days a week.
levels.promotion_message: You chose science over spreadsheets. As a Staff Research Engineer, you touch the models themselves — and only four days a week. Blasphemy.

levels.title: Principal Scientist
levels.description: Publish world-breaking research and bill a fortune for two days of it.
levels.promotion_message: Your paper broke the leaderboard, and the company broke the bank to keep you. Two days a week, a staggering rate, and a standing nap invitation.

levels.title: AI Oracle
levels.description: Your oracle models run the world while you work Fridays and collect a small fortune per day.
levels.promotion_message: Your models now predict everything except when you'll come into the office, because the answer is: Fridays only. Six figures a day, and the rest of the week is yours.

branches.name: Dark Executive Track
branches.description: Take the models commercial. Manipulate, monetize, and climb to a throne built from other sims' data — with a work week that shrinks as your power grows.

levels.title: Director of Dark Patterns
levels.description: Design interfaces sims can't stop tapping, four days a week.
levels.promotion_message: You chose the dark side, and the dark side has a signing bonus. As Director of Dark Patterns, you make sims spend money they don't have on things they don't need.

levels.title: Chief Exploitation Officer
levels.description: Monetize everything, including the guilt, two days a week.
levels.promotion_message: The board loves your plan to charge subscriptions for feelings. Two days a week, five grand an hour, and a conscience you've agreed to leave in the parking garage.

levels.title: CEO, Evil Overlord
levels.description: Rule OmniMind from a corner office, working three days a week for a fortune per day while everyone else grinds.
levels.promotion_message: You did it. You're the CEO, the Evil Overlord, the reason the machines know everyone's secrets. Three days a week, six figures a day, and the rest of the week is yours to spend plotting. Remember the grind that got you here? Neither do your employees. That's the point.

author: CareerForge
